caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a tool, ax, or hammer, positioned centrally against a plain light beige background. The tool features a dark brown handle with a textured, somewhat cylindrical appearance. Attached to the top of the handle is a metal head, also in dark brown hues with shading to suggest a metallic surface. The head has a distinctive form: one side is broad and flat, shaped similarly to an ax blade, while the opposite side divides into two curved prongs that extend outwards, resembling pincers or a claw. The metal head connects directly to the top of the wooden handle. Near the bottom right corner of the drawing, small black text reads "G.J. Fia". There are no other objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Hoe
